apiKey.keyFor: An API key for the LLM provider (default DeepSeek); it can be a local Ollama endpoint instead

evidence.quote:
**Bring your own model** — DeepSeek (default), OpenAI, OpenRouter, local

checkNote: The default provider is DeepSeek (baseURL https://api.deepseek.com) with apiKey "", and the README says "**API key** — your LLM provider's key". Ranking can't run by default without a key. The README lists "local\n  Ollama" as an option, so a local model works.
